out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The hot water at handwashing sink next to the office was 71ºF. The water was allowed to run for 20 minutes, but it did not get hotter.
violations.corrective_action: Hot water at a handwashing sink must be at least 100ºF. A switch had been accidentally turned off in the boiler room. Water was 100ºF at the three compartment sink by the end of the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Observed a few stacked round plastic containers were still wet on the drying shelving.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. The PIC properly stacked the containers during the inspection and discussed this requirement with staff. CDI.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. The hot water at the three compartment sink was 91ºF. The hot water was allowed to run for 20 minutes but the temperature would not rise.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. The PIC contacted maintenance who corrected the issue. A switch had been accidentally turned off. Water was 110ºF at the three compartment sink by the end of the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: two squeeze bottles of ranch dressing and one bottle of Italian dressing were unlabeled in unit #3.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. The person in charge lableled the squeeze bottles during the visit.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the vinyl wall baseboard below the handwashing station is not maintained in good repair, baseboard is peeling off wall - as a result of water damage on the wall.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: OBSERVATIONS: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed shredded lettuce, Cooked corn and Cut apple at 51F, 48 F and 48 F respectively on the cold tray @ front line.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTED DURING INSPECTION: Discussed with manager who removed the items and placed it in the 2 DR Refrigerator. ThTime/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.
